title: 5 by 8 bathroom remodel — supported direct scope

unpriced.name: Waterproofing materials and system validation
unpriced.reason: Full catalog waterproof/membrane/damp-proof searches found no suitable shower system; roofing membranes rejected. Cement board and caulk are not waterproofing. Need compatible membrane, bands, penetration seals and tub-flange treatment for 66.306 SF; labor priced.

unpriced.name: Porcelain floor tile and setting materials
unpriced.reason: Porcelain search found no porcelain row; ceramic floor variants 1636–1651 are not proven matching porcelain specification. Floor installation labor priced, but porcelain tile, compatible thinset/grout and threshold transition material unpriced.

unpriced.name: Exhaust fan material and duct connection consumables
unpriced.reason: Fan/ventilation and adjacent bathroom heater rows inspected. Rows 7328–7334 add a light; heater/attic fan variants have different scope. No plain midgrade 70–80 CFM bath fan material source. Replacement labor priced; retained duct assumed sound.

unpriced.name: Protection consumables and unresolved plumbing incidentals
unpriced.reason: No defensible dedicated protection consumables row found. Tub waste/overflow and vanity trap/supply inclusion not explicit in selected assemblies; normal connection labor included but new material allowance unsupported if not furnished with fixtures.

unpriced.name: Tile edge profiles and doorway threshold materials
unpriced.reason: Thinset ceramic field rows do not identify exposed edge profiles. Wainscot cap variants are not vertical termination/porcelain doorway transition equivalents. Need 12.833 LF vertical edge finish and 2.5 LF threshold; fit labor priced.

assumptions: 60 x 32 x 19 inch acrylic alcove tub, average grade; matching existing footprint.

One 30-inch birch cabinet with nominal 31 x 19 inch integral sink top; catalog 31-inch unit is proxy for top overhang. Existing stops, drains, toilet flange, electrical boxes, circuits and exterior fan duct are serviceable.
Existing small ceramic tile on gypsum surround, thinset ceramic floor over sound wood subfloor; no window, one 30 x 80 inch door opening (16.667 SF).
New ceramic 4-1/4 inch surround tile; porcelain 12-inch square floor tile. Flat latex paint is catalog finish assumption.
No special stairs or long carry; one shared 12 CY dumpster is smallest catalog disposal container.
Assemblies include ordinary fastening, setting and connection labor where integral to installation, but not removal unless explicitly stated. No new whole fixture rough-ins.
Labor mixes omitted: no business rates supplied; source crew averages retained and manhours treated as person-hours.
exclusions: Layout changes, hidden damage, new circuits, new vent routing and unrelated upgrades.

components.name: Disposal
components.rationale: One smallest available dumpster covers all bathroom debris; delivery, haul and fees included. No other disposal line. Capacity minimum exceeds expected few cubic yards.

components.name: Protection
components.rationale: Two laborers x 2 hours for shared route/tub protection setup and removal; excludes trade installation and paint masking. Reusable coverings assumed available; consumables gap recorded.

components.name: Handling Clean
components.rationale: Two laborers x 3 hours total for consolidated loading of staged debris and final vacuum/wipe clean; excludes vanity transport expressly included by removal row and trade spot cleanup.

components.name: Tub Remove
components.rationale: Remove old alcove tub; no reset.

components.name: Vanity Remove
components.rationale: Disconnect and remove old cabinet/sink/faucet to dumpster; not remove-and-replace labor row.

components.name: Toilet Remove
components.rationale: Remove toilet before floor work; new installation separate.

components.name: Mirror Remove
components.rationale: Screw-mounted mirror clips assumed; comparable screwed bathroom accessory removal.

components.name: Walltile Remove
components.rationale: Existing thinset ceramic tiles over same surround area; substrate removal separate.

components.name: Floor Remove
components.rationale: Thinset small ceramic floor over same net floor area.

components.name: Wallboard Remove
components.rationale: Remove underlying gypsum to install wet-area backer; tile removal row covers finish only.

components.name: Electric Remove
components.rationale: One electrician x 1 hour to safely disconnect/remove vanity light and old fan; installation rows do not specify removal.

components.name: Tub Valve Remove
components.rationale: One plumber x 0.75 hour to disconnect/remove old tub valve and trim in opened wall, not tub removal or new assembly installation.

components.category: Tub, faucet, vanity and toilet installation
components.name: Tub
components.rationale: Average 60 x 32 acrylic alcove tub, installed; includes normal setting/drain reconnection labor; no demolition implied by installed row.

components.category: Tub, faucet, vanity and toilet installation
components.name: Tub Faucet
components.rationale: Average complete tub faucet with shower assembly. Do not add separate mixer/showerhead or rough-in rows.

components.category: Tub, faucet, vanity and toilet installation
components.name: Vanity
components.rationale: Birch vanity plus sink top assembly; assume integral basin and routine drain reconnection. 31-inch top proxy for 30-inch cabinet. Do not also charge separate sink or replacement labor.

components.category: Tub, faucet, vanity and toilet installation
components.name: Sink Faucet
components.rationale: Average bathroom faucet with installation, separate from cabinet/sink-top.

components.category: Tub, faucet, vanity and toilet installation
components.name: Toilet
components.rationale: Average two-piece toilet; includes seat and supply plus normal setting/connection.

components.name: Wall Backer
components.rationale: Half-inch cement board for surround. Includes ordinary mounting and seam preparation; waterproof membrane is separate.

components.name: Floor Backer
components.rationale: Quarter-inch cement board over sound subfloor; fastening and ordinary installation bed assumed included. No structural repair.

components.name: Wall Tile
components.rationale: Small ceramic tile thinset assembly includes tile setting and grout as normal completion; not waterproofing, backer or change-of-plane caulk. Net installed area, no labor waste multiplier.

components.name: Wet Caulk
components.rationale: Quarter-inch mildew-resistant wet-area caulk at tub lip and two wall corners; change-of-plane joints separate from grouted tile field.

components.name: Floor Prep
components.rationale: Two-person tile crew x 1 hour scraping residual adhesive, checking floor flatness and vacuuming before board; no hidden damage repair or tile demo duplication.

components.name: Porcelain Labor
components.rationale: Two-person tile crew x 4 hours for layout/cutting/setting/grouting 26.667 SF small porcelain floor; no porcelain/thinset/grout material priced. Crew average per person $36.97.

components.name: Waterproof Labor
components.rationale: Two-person tile crew x 2 active hours sealing penetrations/corners and applying compatible membrane coats to 66.306 SF; excludes passive cure time and backer seams. Waterproof system materials unpriced.

components.name: Edge Finishing
components.rationale: Two-person tile crew x 0.5 hours total to fit exposed vertical surround edge profiles (12.833 LF) and doorway threshold (2.5 LF); distinct from field tile setting. Profile and threshold materials unpriced.

components.category: Vanity light and fan replacement labor
components.name: Light
components.rationale: Average wall light bar, same bathroom function as requested; catalog incandescent-type fixture assumed rather than integrated LED. Connection included.

components.category: Vanity light and fan replacement labor
components.name: Fan Install
components.rationale: One electrician x 2.5 hours to fit replacement 70–80 CFM fan, reconnect existing duct/wiring, seal joint and test. No new duct or circuit; fan material unavailable in exact specification.

components.name: Mirror
components.rationale: Clear framed plate-glass mirror, one unit exactly as Ea; catalog omits dimensions, assumes typical vanity-size mirror, not area pricing.

components.name: Paint Wash
components.rationale: Wet clean paint surfaces before coating.

components.name: Paint Sand
components.rationale: Light sand existing paint before first coat.

components.name: Paint Patch
components.rationale: 12 SF localized normal anchor holes/edges from mirror/light and tile interface; no hidden damage.

components.name: Paint Prime
components.rationale: Spot seal repaired areas only, before finish coats.

components.name: Paint
components.rationale: Two-coat roller assembly; quantity is surface area once, not twice. Flat latex explicitly assumed catalog specification.

components.name: Paint Detail
components.rationale: One painter x 2 hours masking fixtures and cutting in room perimeter/tile/door on both coats; additional detailed brushwork to roller assembly, no duplicate rolling or shared route protection.
